messages:
Maria: Heads-up — I bumped into a new token-tail latency spike on route /chat/generate around 21:04 UTC. Correlates with SM thermal excursions on MIG slice 2 and a sudden drop in SM occupancy for kernel_v3_select. Dashboard: https://graf.redwood/internal/d/rt/slice-thermal?panel=7 :thermometer:
Ajit: Thanks — can you paste the perf flame or pprof snapshot? curious if the kernel fallback path is being picked repeatedly.
Maria: pprof attached (small snippet):
```
flamegraph: kernel_v3_select -> kernel_v2_fallback -> kv_cache_wait  (70%)
sm_occupancy{slice="2"} drops from 95% -> 40% within 3s
power_watts{gpu="a100-3"} spikes +18W
```
Kevin: Noted. I see the kernel selector metrics spiking in our prod-metrics. Might be the tiebreaker scoring using VRAM headroom incorrectly.
Hana: Do we have a PromQL that shows kernel switch rate vs thermal? I'll pull.
Kevin: Quick query I used: 
```promql
sum(increase(kernel_selector.switch_count[1m])) by (kernel) / sum(increase(requests[1m]))
```
shows kernel_v3_select switching to kernel_v2_fallback ~0.22 of requests during the event.
Maria: Also saw KV prefetch miss rate climb 3x on the same timeframe — could be eviction churn when SM occupancy drops.
Ajit: Could be memory pressure -> prefetch disabled -> more KV cache misses -> longer tails. Two-pronged: investigate kernel tiebreaker and prefetch aggressiveness.
Luke: +1. Can we reproduce on staging with thermal throttle emulation? I can spin a small MIG slice and run the replay.
Maria: Yes please, replay id: replay-214005-thermal. Load generator: `tools/replay --trace replay-214005-thermal --rate 150 rps`.
infra-bot: Canary deploy started for commit sha: a1b2c3d — route /chat/generate -> kernel-override:kernel_v2_fallback (temp)
Hana: Quick idea: add a soft penalty to kernel_score if recent power variance > 10W for slice. Should reduce oscillation.
Ajit: Sounds reasonable. I'll prototype a small change to kernel_selector: add feature power_stddev(window=30s) and weight -0.3. If it passes perf-tests, we can canary.
Kevin: Also can we tune kv-prefetch to be more conservative under low SM occupancy? Maybe scale prefetch window by occupancy ratio.
Maria: Agreed. For tracking: created issue RNW-ops/infra#2768 with steps, links to dashboards and replay.
Luke: I'll run the staging replay now and capture pprof/pprof flame + telemetry. Will report within 45m.
Maria: Thanks all — marking blocking until we verify canary effect. If the canary reduces kernel switch rate and tail latency -> promote. :thumbsup:
